Class AbstractLetterProgression

java.lang.Object
aslframework.game.progression.AbstractLetterProgression
All Implemented Interfaces:
LetterProgression
Direct Known Subclasses:
DifficultyProgression, SequentialProgression
public abstract class AbstractLetterProgression extends Object implements LetterProgression
Base class for letter progressions that share cursor management.

Subclasses provide the ordered letter list via buildLetterList(); this class handles all cursor state (currentIndex, advance(), isExhausted(), etc.) so subclasses contain only ordering logic.
